findings.finding: Runbook step 3 references deprecated database host payment-db-v3 (status: deprecated in CMDB). Current active database is payment-db.
findings.remediation: Update runbook step 3 to reference payment-db (active, version 14.2) instead of payment-db-v3 (deprecated, version 11.4).

findings.finding: Rollback plan relies on restoring pre-migration database backup, but change includes schema migration (pr_scope_flags.schema_migration=true). Schema migration with ALTER TABLE is irreversible — restoring backup would lose all transactions processed after migration.
findings.remediation: Design a forward-compatible rollback: add column as nullable, deploy API that handles both with/without currency, prepare a migration-down script that drops the column only if no data written.

findings.finding: Service payment-api + category schema_migration has 2 prior P2 incidents (INC-2026-0234, INC-2025-3102). Pattern suggests elevated risk for schema migrations on payment infrastructure.

matching_incidents.root_cause_summary: Column type mismatch after migration caused payment failures for 45 minutes
Migration lock contention caused 2-hour payment processing delay

findings.remediation: Add migration lock timeout configuration and column type verification step to runbook. Consider off-peak schema migration with explicit lock monitoring.
